The '''Alui system''' was located in the [[Alui sector/Legends|Alui sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Duros Space Run]],<ref name="DurosSpaceRun" /> which linked it to the [[Enarc system/Legends|Enarc system]]<ref name="TEA" /> as well as the [[Verdanth system/Legends|Verdanth system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="OuterRim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors|text=The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> and it also shared its name with the [[Alui Corridor]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route.<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> Shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Alui [[Star system/Legends|system]] was the site of a civilian-operated Class II [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] whose output was limited to [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Alui system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-17.<ref name="TEA" />
